body: I am bigger than elephant but lighter than a feather. What am I?
I am black and white and full of fuzz. What am I?
I am black and white. I have strings I have keys. I make sound without my lips. I make dough with no flour. What am I?
I am black as night but can be filled with light. Through me things can be seen, although it is a screen. What am I?
I am black when you buy me, red when you use me, when I turn white. You know it's time to throw me away. What am I?
I am black within and red without, With four corners round about. What am I?
I am black, white and read all over. What am I?
I am blinding at times yet help you see. I am necessary but you'll burn with too much of me. What am I?
I am born in fear, raised in truth and I come to my own in deed. When comes a time that I'm called forth, I come to serve the cause of need?
I am born in fear, raised in truth and I come to my own in deed. When comes a time that I'm called forth, I come to serve the cause of need. What am I?
I am bought by the yard but worn by the foot. What am I?
I am brown and sticky. What am I?
I am bushy headed but have no air. No moisture will not enter my skin but it's good at keeping it in. What am I?
I am but three holes. When you come out of me, you are still inside me. What am I?
I am clean when I'm black, dirty when I'm white. What am I?
I am commonly abbreviated to H. What am I?
I am commonly ate before I'm born and after I'm dead. What am I?
I am constantly overlooked by everyone but everyone has me. What am I?
I am drawn by everyone without pen or pencil. What am I?
I am easy to see but no one likes looking at me. Without me, there would be no you. I can make you complain, or make you happy. But you almost always take me for granted. What am I?
I am easy to waste and unstoppable What am I?
I am edible, pink and a great summer food. What am I?
I am enjoyed by some, despised by others. Some take me for granted, some treasure me like a gift. I last forever, unless you break me first. What am I?
I am enjoyed with a pot and some pointy sticks. What am I?
I am essential to life on earth! I am split into thirds. Two thirds are the same. One of the thirds is 8. The other two are 1 each. What am I?
I am everywhere but cannot be seen captured or held, only heard, what am I?
I am everywhere. I am inside you. I surround you. I can be seen by you. I can kill you. Yet you play in me. What am I?
I am expelled from you orally with a sound. What am I?
I am filled with garb, the price is free. Just return what you don't need. What am I?
I am flora, not fauna, I am foliage, not trees, I am shrubbery, not grass?
I am flora, not fauna. I am foliage, not trees. I am shrubbery, not grass. What am I?
I am found by the ocean and offer you a bed. Whether you want me or not, to your house I am led?
I am free for the taking. Through all of your life, though given but once at birth. I am less than nothing in weight but will fell the strongest of you if held?
I am free the first time and second time but the third time is going to cost you money. What am I?
I am full of holes but still holds water. What am I?
I am full of wisdom and knowledge. I get what you want in a blink of an eye. I am known to man as full of endless wisdom. What am I?
I am fun and sad. I am fast and slow. I get louder and I get softer. And I am created by great geniuses. What am I?
I am gentle enough to soothe your skin, light enough to fly in the sky, strong enough to crack rocks. What am I?
I am gold and can be black and white, I'm a symbol for a nation, when freedom took flight. What am I?
I am good at concealing what's real and hide what's true. Sometime, I bring out the courage in you! What am I?
I am green and ugly and come out at night with a crumple old broom. Who am I?
I am green but not a tree. You can see me and sit on me and I grow around the world. What am I?
I am heavy forward but backward I'm not. What am I?
I am higher than the king. What am I?
I am hot then cold, a liquid then solid and I am at once flaky and wet. What am I?
I am in the middle of water but am not an island. What am I?
I am in the middle of water but not an island. What am I?
I am in the past, never in the future. I don't exist but have existed. I saw what you saw and this is what I will ever see. What am I?
I am in the sky but also in the ground. When you study me, no matter how long, I will always end with an f. I may be in your yard but not in your house. What am I?
I am in the sky. I'm white, I'm round but not always. Sometimes you see me, sometimes you don't. What am I?
